title: Sage water_surface record
description: A water_surface record (WaterSurfaceRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another water_surface record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

colour.description: The water's own colour: what deep water and the far depths fade to (lit by the sky) Category: Colour. (Vector3, default [0.05,0.15,0.18])

fogDensity.description: How fast the bottom disappears into the colour: 1 - exp(-density x metres of water looked through) Unit: 1/m. At least 0. Category: Colour. (float, default 0.35)

shoreFade.description: Water shallower than this fades out toward the shore, so the edge is soft and not a line on the bank. Unit: m. At least 0. Category: Colour. (float, default 0.6)

reflectivity.description: How much it mirrors: the Fresnel reflection's strength (1: a still lake at a glancing angle is a mirror) Range: 0 to 1. Category: Light. (float, default 1)

refraction.description: How far the ripples bend what is seen through the water, as a fraction of the screen per unit of tilt. Range: 0 to 0.2. Category: Light. (float, default 0.03)

specular.description: The sun's glint on the ripples. At least 0. Category: Light. (float, default 1.5)

waveLength.description: The length of the longest ripple; three shorter ones ride on it. Unit: m. At least 0.05. Category: Waves. (float, default 4)

waveStrength.description: How steep the ripples are (the most the surface tilts); 0 is a mirror-flat pond. Range: 0 to 1. Category: Waves. (float, default 0.12)

waveSpeed.description: How fast the longest ripple travels; shorter ones travel slower, as on real water. Unit: m/s. At least 0. Category: Waves. (float, default 0.8)

waveDirection.description: Which way the ripples travel: 0 is +x, 90 is +z. Unit: deg. Category: Waves. (float, default 30)

underwaterColour.description: What the view fades into with the camera under the surface. Category: Underwater. (Vector3, default [0.04,0.16,0.2])

underwaterDensity.description: How thick the water is to look through from inside it: 1 - exp(-density x metres) Unit: 1/m. At least 0. Category: Underwater. (float, default 0.12)

underwaterTint.description: What everything seen from under the surface is multiplied by: water swallows red first. Category: Underwater. (Vector3, default [0.55,0.8,0.85])
